# dr_mp3

Unmodified `dr_mp3.h` from https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs
commit `a466dbe88fe2576d46c43877d602f3d66b8561a7`.
SHA-256: `390e4e0ef0cff80fb86ebf1b461d6947cfa4ed699a4fe107e5a5e69a47db2950`.

Dual public-domain (Unlicense) / MIT-0 license is included at the end of the
header; this project uses the MIT-0 option. See the complete notice there.
No third-party music or game payload is included. Compiled natively once in
source/runtime/audio_decoder.cpp with DR_MP3_NO_STDIO. PCM storage is streamed;
compressed input is an owned VFS snapshot bounded to32 MiB.
